title: Pari E2e Precision Resource Bridge
objective: Audit and minimally prove composition of resident exact Fmpz owners with declared Arb precision retries across a native Python import graph; add compiler machinery only if a minimal reproducer proves it missing

handoff.summary: Audited the existing native resource graph and demonstrated that it already composes caller-owned exact FmpzMatrix state with imported Arb precision work across a cloned native Python call graph. The focused bridge forces a 32-to-128-bit retry, preserves an arbitrary-precision exact owner, publishes precision-dependent output only after successful recomputation and exact-state revalidation, and matches JavaScript, GMP, native, and independent CPython Decimal enclosure oracles. Invalid over-capacity and aliased-resource calls fail without mutating exact, published, or diagnostic state. No compiler, FFI, or handwritten native change is justified: declared resource identity, ownership, and dynamic fallback already suffice.
risks: The authentic getfu retry trace reaches p2176 and p2240, while its coordinated regulator and elementary-function caps currently range from p1856 through p2048. Supporting a p2240 exponential requires at least p2304 working precision and must widen every dependent cap with a forced-retry regression; this is a separate algorithm-capacity task, not a resource-graph defect.
Validation was executed on Linux x64. The source-transparent graph uses existing portable declared resources, but Linux ARM64, Windows x64, and macOS ARM64 were not executed in this lane.

The repository-wide test:changed run reached 222 of 245 unit files before the pre-existing modular-qexp package-graph source-freeze mismatch (expected 66d0..., base reports acf5...), outside this lane's claims. Focused, architecture, strict-Python, and complete native gates pass.
next_steps: Integrate this reproducer and audit as the ownership contract for composing exact relation/HNF owners with unit-lattice precision retries.

In a dedicated getfu precision lane, raise regulator, division, square-root, modular-log, logarithm, product, sum, resize, integer-to-real, and exponential capacities coherently through at least p2304, then force and verify the p2176/p2240 retry path.

Have the shared end-to-end driver retain exact owners as authoritative state, allocate precision-dependent scratch resources per attempt, and copy to published resources only after all exact and enclosure checks pass.
